design: No zoi.listings column/default/row-shape change. A private RLS-enabled per-listing epoch is established lazily only by a successful newly source-reviewed canonical write. No population seeding or legacy receipt re-signing.

New immutable canonical input covers listing identity/branch, exact canonical and published address/city/country/website overrides, source registration/trust and geographic field metadata, source identity/holds, ownership, visibility, point/precision and the complete _geo provenance/request binding. Menu/content/media/hours/coverage/crawl timestamps/updated_at are excluded.

An AFTER UPDATE trigger sees the final row and advances an existing epoch only for a relevant input change. It creates no epoch for an unreviewed listing. A change away and back cannot revive the earlier receipt. Listing lock precedes private epoch mutation; no listing update or competing job store is introduced.

New nullable private geography_reviews.read_authority_fingerprint captures SHA256 of the narrow input plus epoch after the canonical actual write. Legacy NULL receipts retain the original strict full-row comparison.

The actual writer retains every full-row application/source/snapshot/independence/CAS/replay check. It additionally refuses held or contradictory published source/address overrides, lazily establishes the epoch and records read authority. Full-row geography_fingerprint and geography_review_revert definitions remain byte-identical.

The public reviewed-point RPC returns the original five-field shape and retains exact existing ACL/public eligibility/reverted/wrong-request/wrong-point gates. New receipts compare narrow authority; legacy receipts compare the full row. An exact validated _geo request UUID enables the existing request-ID primary-key lookup; no new review-table scan/index is required.
